clips.title: The story
paras: Tinkers' Court is the grand council chamber at the heart of Gnomeregan. Once the bustling seat of the High Tinker and his ruling council, it is now the grim stronghold of the traitor Mekgineer Thermaplugg.

Before the disaster that ruined Gnomeregan, the Tinkers' Court served as the civic and political heart of the nation. It was here that High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque gathered with advisors and master inventors, including Tinkmaster Overspark, to debate technological advancements, govern civic matters, and guide gnomish society. The court represented the pinnacle of gnomish ingenuity and governance, situated just beyond the industrial works of the Engineering Labs and the Launch Bay.
